research_role: financial-domain sentiment transfer; not a replication of the original equity study and not a direct price-prompt challenger

frozen_input_contract.contract_text: Treat every nonempty line in a daily information set as one metadata-prefixed headline. Remove the leading metadata bracket. Classify each title independently with ProsusAI FinBERT at max length 128. Daily score equals the arithmetic mean of positive probability minus negative probability. Daily confidence equals the arithmetic mean of the largest class probability. Errors remain explicit and market outcomes are not used.

stage1_operational_gate.sample: 12 deterministic stratified calendar days per year, 2017-2025
stage1_operational_gate.failure_action: stop before full inference, calibration or backtest

stage2_predictive_gate_if_stage1_passes.allowed_work: one full inference followed by calibration only
stage2_predictive_gate_if_stage1_passes.endpoint: BTCUSDT forward 24-hour return using the existing causal target builder
primary_tests: Pearson correlation between continuous daily sentiment score and forward return
top-tercile minus bottom-tercile mean forward return
stage2_predictive_gate_if_stage1_passes.pass_rule: the lower bound of both predeclared confidence intervals must be greater than zero
stage2_predictive_gate_if_stage1_passes.failure_action: stop before trading threshold selection or backtest

anti_shopping_rule: FinBERT is evaluated because it is the paper-linked financial sentiment baseline. Its result must be retained whether positive or negative, and no checkpoint may be selected by trading return.
